Completed work: wrote and executed a complete, reproducible `analysis.py` (no CLI arguments, ~4 s CPU, fixed seed 20260117, byte-identical reruns verified) and produced all five required artifacts at their exact contracted paths: `results/state_estimates.csv`, `results/filter_diagnostics.csv`, `results/summary.json`, `results/overview.png`, `results/conclusion.txt`. All numeric CSV/JSON fields are finite (programmatically verified), covariances strictly positive, and every required summary key is present.

METHOD (data-inferred): Bootstrap particle filter, N=1500 (contract limit 1500), log-domain weights throughout (used_log_weights=true), fixed seed. Channel semantics inferred from the data: ch0 = range-like (strictly positive, 0.523..4.085), ch1 = bearing-like (radians, confined to [-pi,pi]). Measurement model h(x)=[hypot(px,py), atan2(py,px)] with wrap-aware bearing residuals; per-channel mixture likelihood (95% Gaussian sigma_r=0.03 / sigma_b=0.02 + 5% heavy tail at 8x sigma) for impulsive-outlier robustness (no observations deleted or replaced); masked channels are skipped exactly as proposed, with bearing_residual_mean/std falling back to the documented finite 0.0 proxy at all 9 masked-bearing steps. Motion: constant velocity + random-walk acceleration with an IMM-lite CV/CT proposal mixture and NIS-triggered adaptive process-noise inflation; likelihood tempering (sigma_eff = max(sigma, 0.8 x predicted cloud spread), an EnKF-like gain limit) prevents chronic weight degeneracy on this near-noiseless stream; a guarded degeneracy-recovery injection exists but never fired.

KEY DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY (also in conclusion.txt):
- Variant comparison: the bearing-bias-state (5-D) variant WON over the inflation-only variant on innovation whiteness — lag-1 autocorrelation of the per-step bearing residual series +0.322 vs +0.372 (mean +0.031 vs +0.033), with corroboration from proxy accuracy (pos 0.212 vs 0.254) and higher min ESS (23.5 vs 12.1). Rationale: whiter residuals indicate the augmented model absorbed the slow systematic component.
- ESS / resampling: ESS min 23.5, mean 693.8, median 744.5 (N=1500); 48 systematic resampling events (trigger ESS < 750); weight_degeneracy_detected = true (criterion min ESS < N/20); weight entropy mean 6.62 nats.
- Angle wrapping: angle_wrapping_detected = true, angle_wrap_event_count = 1 (bearing +3.1376 -> -3.1303 between t=5 and t=6, crossing +pi); wrap-aware residuals used throughout; no wrap inside the 55-63 bearing gap.
- Maneuver adaptation events (timings): 6 NIS-triggered inflations at t = 17, 36, 41, 49, 72, 79 (q_mult -> 1.70, decaying 0.88/step); t=36 is the genuine close-pass bearing sweep, the others are the identified impulsive outliers (~5 at t~17, 41, 49, 72, 79, handled by the mixture likelihood).
- Close-pass handling verified: the estimate sweeps smoothly through the t=34-40 pass (range minimum 0.523, ~1.7 rad bearing sweep per step), px -0.54 -> +1.15, vy -0.002 -> +0.199, no track jump; largest proxy deviation is the bearing-only gap t=22-31 (max d_pos 1.10 at t=31, expected radial unobservability, re-lock to 0.03 within 2 steps of range data returning).
- PROXY DISCLAIMER (prominent in conclusion.txt): the true trajectory is not public, so rmse_pos / rmse_vel / nees (and summary pos_rmse / vel_rmse / mean_nees = 0.2117 / 0.0643 / 0.695, median 0.103) are PROXIES against a robust regularized smooth-trajectory reference fitted to the public measurements — they are NOT absolute ground-truth errors.
- overview.png: rendered without matplotlib (unavailable, no network) via a pure-stdlib PNG encoder (zlib+struct); the encoded file was re-parsed and verified decodable (signature, IHDR 1280x980 8-bit RGB, IHDR/IDAT/IEND present, all chunk CRCs OK, IDAT decompresses to exactly h*(3w+1) bytes, all row filters 0; 29,846 bytes); raster inspection confirms all four intended panels contain content (5,077-16,026 non-background pixels each).

Data-inferred structure reported in conclusion.txt: uniform dt=1.0 (95 steps), ch0 missing steps 22-31, ch1 missing steps 55-63, ~5 joint impulsive outliers, non-CV maneuvering (close pass t~34-38, bearing-rate reversal after t~55).
